title: Reproduce and bound concurrent unsigned registry lookups in KajiLink.serve
goal: A committed regression shows concurrent unsigned requests while the child is slow fill the nervous process queue; after the fix inbound lookups share one in-flight call and legitimate requests still pass
acceptance: A committed deterministic regression fails before the fix: concurrent unsigned requests while the child is slow fill the process queue
After the fix concurrent inbound lookups share one in-flight bases() call and the child is not flooded
Legitimate signed requests and heartbeats still pass
Revocation still takes effect on the next lookup
No timeout or queue bound is widened, and no assertion is weakened
privacy: Neutral repository fixtures only; no model inference, private hosts or device operations
validation: test/periodic-overlap.test.ts fails before the fix and passes after it
Affected Kaji link and cross-base regressions; full test suite
Fresh-context security/design review before the parent closes
escalation: Do not merely widen timeouts or the queue bound, or weaken assertions
Stop if revocation freshness cannot be maintained across lookups

effort.basis: Task added 2026-11-12 when B-051 was taken up. Baseline 1.5 h agent (baselineAgentHours), the estimate recorded when B-051 was opened. Regression test committed first (951c779), coalesced in-flight bases() lookup in KajiLink (PR #291), review and CI. Closed 2026-11-12 after PR #291 merged into main 9497e89 with all CI jobs passing.
